INSERT INTO document_intelligence (
  request_id,
  file_name,
  document_format,
  document_type,
  classification_confidence,
  extracted_text,
  word_count,
  character_count,
  language_detected,
  primary_ocr_provider,
  ocr_agreement_score,
  tables_extracted,
  key_value_pairs_extracted,
  entities_extracted,
  document_metadata,
  providers_used,
  pages_processed,
  processing_time_ms
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.request_id }}',
  '{{ $json.document_info.file_name }}',
  '{{ $json.document_info.format }}',
  '{{ $json.document_classification?.document_type || "unknown" }}',
  {{ $json.document_classification?.confidence || 'NULL' }},
  '{{ $json.text_extraction.primary_text }}',
  {{ $json.text_extraction.word_count }},
  {{ $json.text_extraction.character_count }},
  '{{ $json.text_extraction.language }}',
  '{{ $json.text_extraction.primary_provider }}',
  {{ $json.text_extraction.ocr_agreement_score || 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.structured_data.tables.length }},
  {{ $json.structured_data.key_value_pairs.length }},
  {{ $json.structured_data.entities.length }},
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.document_classification?.metadata || {}) }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.metadata.providers_used) }}',
  {{ $json.metadata.pages_processed }},
  {{ $json.metadata.processing_time_ms }}
) RETURNING *;
